text:
ali_cs: Quick triage - Cascade Labs onboarding suddenly spiked token burn overnight (~3.5x). Embeddings are 84% of traffic. Need an immediate safety plan and a 1-line QBR note.
rachel_finops: Oof. Can we get route %, current daily pace, and a 7-day projection at this rate?
omar_se: Console snippet: /v1/embeddings = 84% of tokens, current ~2.0M tokens/day -> 7d ~14M. Origin looks like their enrichment pipeline re-generating vectors on every run due to a mis-set "force_recompute" flag.
ali_cs: Immediate asks: 1) temporary credit buffer + alerts, 2) apply per-route soft throttle, 3) flip their enrichment to incremental dedupe + delta-only embeddings, 4) schedule enablement with Mei tomorrow AM.
rachel_finops: I'll provision a 20% cushion and add alerts at 70%/90% of that buffer. Also will compute token->$ delta for the QBR bullet.
mei_enablement: I can run a 30-min session: cover dedupe patterns, delta-only embedding flows, adaptive sampling, and switching to a smaller/base embed model for bulk ops. Morning PT works.
omar_se: Mitigation plan implemented: set soft cap /v1/embeddings -> 850k tokens/day; rolled the enrichment to incremental mode (dedupe + only-delta uploads); enabled short-term result cache. Monitoring now.
safety-bot: Created alert "cascade-embed-buffer-70-90" (ID: SB-3217). Playbook suggested:
```
1) add 20% temp credit buffer to account
2) set soft cap: /v1/embeddings -> 850k tokens/day
3) change enrichment to incremental/delta-only + enable cache
4) schedule enablement + 24h follow-up
```
ali_cs: For QBR slide please capture single-line hypothesis + mitigation + next step. Keep it concise.
omar_se: Draft slide line: "Hypothesis: enrichment pipeline forced full recompute each run, causing repeated dense embed calls; Mitigation: incremental/delta embeddings + soft cap + cache; Next: monitor 24h and include playbook in QBR."
rachel_finops: Adding numbers: projected post-mitigation pace ~0.55M tokens/day, token reduction and $ delta included. Cushion provisioned and alerts live.
mei_enablement: I'll record the enablement and attach a 1-page playbook with code snippets for incremental embedding and sample configs for switching to smaller embed models during bulk ops.
ali_cs: Action owners: rachel_finops -> cushion + slide, omar_se -> caps + pipeline change (done), mei_enablement -> enablement. I'll re-evaluate renewal risk in 24h.
omar_se: Implemented changes and monitoring dashboards look good (reacted :thumbsup:).
safety-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 24h (2730001601).
ali_cs: Thanks team. If metrics hold, we'll clear the renewal flag and attach the playbook to the QBR packet.
